summary: Two sections. Section A has four 5-mark theory questions that each want a concept plus a workplace example (POLC, efficiency vs effectiveness, personality models). Section B has two short case scenarios (8 and 7 marks) where you identify the OB concept at work, explain the behaviour, and suggest measures. The paper asks you to use examples and scenarios from an organizational setup in every answer.
paper_format: MST Fall 2026 (2 Sep 2026): all questions compulsory, attempt in stated sequence. Section A: 4 questions x 5 marks = 20. Section B: two case questions, 8 and 7 marks = 15.
question_verbs: Explain ... demonstrating its application through a practical example
Compare ... highlighting the distinction through an example
marks_structure: 5-mark theory: definition or framework, each part explained, one organizational example
8-mark case: name the factors at work, link each to the case facts, explain why behaviour changes across situations
7-mark case: evaluate the influences, then give practical measures
repeated_topics: Personality at work (Big Five, Type A and Type B, locus of control and self-efficacy)
Global and cultural challenges for OB, work-life balance
sources: Photos of the printed MST paper, HR5202, Fall 2026 (2 Sep 2026), 2 pages
